name: Tartarus
description: Apps and agent operating systems from the Tartarus ecosystem.

apps.name: Bident
apps.tagline: A live 3D intelligence console for planet Earth.
apps.description: Photorealistic 3D globe with live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras, plus hands-free voice control. Works without API keys; optional keys are added inside the app.

apps.name: E2E Testing OS
apps.tagline: End-to-end testing operating system for coding agents.
apps.description: Skill pack for planning, writing and running end-to-end tests with your agents. Installs into the agent skill folders Tartarus manages.
